# `<sl-description-list>` — Description List

> **Only in Saipem DS.** This component does not exist in upstream Shoelace or Web Awesome: use only the API below.

Description lists show a grid of label/value pairs, e.g. a document's properties.

**Status:** experimental · **Since:** 2.20

**Import:** `import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/description-list/description-list.js';`

## Attributes

Every attribute is also a property (camelCase name in the second column when it differs). Boolean attributes are on when present: never write `="false"`, remove the attribute or bind the property instead.

| Attribute | Property | Type / allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cols` | — | `number` | `2` | The number of columns to arrange items into. Items wrap onto a new row after this many. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | One or more `<sl-description-list-item>` elements. |

## CSS parts

Parts exist for fine adjustments. Do not use them to change colours, borders or fonts: a missing look is a missing variant of the DS.

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `base` | The component's base wrapper. |

## Documentation and examples

Each [sl-description-list-item](#) is a label/value pair. Values can be plain text or richer content, e.g. an
`<sl-tag>`.

```html
<sl-description-list>
  <sl-description-list-item label="Revision Code">A1</sl-description-list-item>
  <sl-description-list-item label="Second Revision Code">—</sl-description-list-item>
  <sl-description-list-item label="Title">test_review_doc_0009</sl-description-list-item>
</sl-description-list>
```

```ts
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/description-list/description-list.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/description-list-item/description-list-item.js';
import { Component, CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-description-list-example',
  schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA],
  template: `
    <sl-description-list>
      <sl-description-list-item label="Revision Code">A1</sl-description-list-item>
      <sl-description-list-item label="Second Revision Code">—</sl-description-list-item>
      <sl-description-list-item label="Title">test_review_doc_0009</sl-description-list-item>
    </sl-description-list>
  `
})
export class DescriptionListExampleComponent {}
```

## Examples

### Columns

Set `cols` to control how many items sit on a row before wrapping. Defaults to 2.

```html
<sl-description-list cols="3">
  <sl-description-list-item label="Client Document Identification">test_review_doc_0009</sl-description-list-item>
  <sl-description-list-item label="Vendor Document Identification">test_review_doc_0009</sl-description-list-item>
  <sl-description-list-item label="Document Type">External Job Document</sl-description-list-item>
  <sl-description-list-item label="Second Issuing Description">test_review_doc_0001</sl-description-list-item>
  <sl-description-list-item label="Superseded By">—</sl-description-list-item>
  <sl-description-list-item label="Document Status">Received</sl-description-list-item>
</sl-description-list>
```

### Rich values

```html
<sl-description-list>
  <sl-description-list-item label="Created on">02-Oct-2026</sl-description-list-item>
  <sl-description-list-item label="Expires on">
    25-Jun-2026 <sl-tag size="small" variant="warning">Acquired</sl-tag>
  </sl-description-list-item>
</sl-description-list>
```
